source_refs.note: Roman Urdu introduction to mass spectrometry (PDF 195).

blocks.text: Mass spectrometry na-maloom compounds pehchanne ki analytical technique (tajziye ka tareeqa) hai. Chhote se sample ke molecules ya atoms par zyada energy wale electrons ki bombardment (bauchhaar, zor se takrana) ki jati hai, jis se molecule ya atom ka aik electron nikal sakta hai. Is tarah aik positive ion banta hai jise detector pakarta hai, aur use m/e (ion ke mass aur charge ki ratio) ke muqable ions ke percentage ki shakal mein record kiya jata hai.

blocks.prompt: Mass spectrum ka horizontal (ufqi, letay hue) axis kya dikhata hai?
blocks.explanation: m/e, yani har ion ke mass aur charge ki ratio. Aik charge wale ion ke liye yeh us ka mass hi hai.

items: Electrons ki bombardment se positive ions bante hain.
Mass spectrum: m/e ke muqable ions ka percentage.
